diff_causality.evidence: This line introduces the vulnerable pattern by reading from wsgi.input using unvalidated length. Reverting would prevent the uncontrolled resource allocation at this specific point.

security_control.evidence: Required control: Request size limiting/throttling. Required because CWE-770 specifically addresses unlimited resource allocation.
